summary: KAN-92 branch fixes the prior blockers on main: Header/Sidebar now bind User.avatar (not avatarUrl), avatar removal persists via 'avatar' in input merge in user.service.ts and previewUrl() ?? undefined in profile-form, layout/CSS styling is added, and tests cover avatar clearing and header image rendering. Upload, validation, preview, persistence (localStorage), and cross-surface display satisfy all eight ACs. Remaining gaps are minor (no sidebar avatar spec, MIME-only validation, npm test not executed in review environment).

gaps: No dedicated success toast on file selection alone; success banner appears on form save (profile.component.ts:64-68), which aligns with the save-to-persist workflow but is slightly indirect for 'upload actions' AC wording.
evidence: profile-form.component.ts:36-48 Change Image file input with accept .jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp.
profile-form.component.ts:464-472 MIME validation and 2MB size cap with avatarError messages.
profile-form.component.ts:482-484 removeImage() + onSubmit avatar: previewUrl() ?? undefined.
header.component.html:72-73 and sidebar.component.html:10-11 now use profileUser()?.avatar (diff hunk).
profile.component.html:29-30 displays user.avatar on Profile page.
user.service.ts:684-689 persistUsers writes avatar to localStorage.

gaps: File input is not reset after selection; re-selecting the same file may not fire change (profile-form.component.ts:457-479).
evidence: user.service.ts:218 avatar: 'avatar' in input ? input.avatar : existing.avatar clears avatar when { avatar: undefined } passed.
profile-form.component.ts:513 uses ?? so null previewUrl becomes undefined (not skipped).
profile-form.component.ts:475-478 FileReader sets previewUrl immediately on valid upload.
ProfileService passes input.avatar through to userService create/update (profile.service.ts:63,90).

gaps: Large base64 avatars stored in localStorage may inflate users payload; no service-layer size guard beyond client 2MB check.
evidence: Diff touches 9 files only: user.service, profile-form, header, sidebar (+ specs/CSS).
Header initials fallback unchanged when avatar absent (header.component.html:74-76).
Property rename avatarUrl→avatar aligns with user.model.ts:14 field name.

gaps: No sidebar.component.spec.ts asserting img.sidebar-avatar renders when user.avatar set.
No integration test for avatar surviving simulated page refresh (localStorage reload).
npm test not executed in review environment (npm unavailable).
evidence: profile-form.component.spec.ts:108-139 covers valid upload, invalid format, oversized file.
profile-form.component.spec.ts:165-185 clears avatar when removed and form saved.
user.service.spec.ts:104-120 clears avatar when explicitly removed.
header.component.spec.ts:138-153 renders img.avatar-img when user.avatar set.

gaps: Avatar upload UI styles duplicated inline in profile-form component styles block rather than shared stylesheet (acceptable for scoped component).
evidence: profile-form.component.ts:317-405 adds profile-avatar-section, avatar-container, btn-secondary, sr-only styles (diff +92 lines).
header.component.css:133-138 .avatar-img object-fit:cover; sidebar.component.css:46-51 .sidebar-avatar sizing.
Consistent avatar property naming across layout templates and User model.

gaps: Validation relies on file.type MIME only; extension spoofing possible (profile-form.component.ts:464-467).
evidence: Avatar stored as data URL in localStorage via user.service persistUsers; no external upload endpoint.
accept attribute restricts file picker to image extensions (profile-form.component.ts:41).

gaps: 2MB limit and supported formats documented only in inline error strings, not README or constants.
evidence: Ticket has no docs/logging AC; profile.component.ts success banner covers save feedback.
avatarError role=alert provides accessible error feedback (profile-form.component.ts:51-52).

findings.title: No sidebar avatar rendering test
findings.detail: Header spec covers img.avatar-img when avatar set; sidebar has no equivalent spec despite template change to profileUser()?.avatar.

findings.title: MIME-only file type validation
findings.detail: allowedTypes checks file.type only; a renamed non-image file with spoofed MIME could pass client validation.

findings.title: No refresh-persistence integration test
findings.detail: Avatar persistence relies on UserService localStorage round-trip; no spec reloads storage to verify post-refresh display.

checklist: All eight KAN-92 ACs addressed: upload, update/remove, format validation, error messages, immediate preview, localStorage persistence, Header/Sidebar/Profile display, responsive CSS.
Prior main blockers fixed: avatarUrl→avatar, avatar removal merge logic, layout/CSS styles.
Run npm test on Node >=22.22.3 in CI to confirm full suite passes.
Optional: add sidebar.component.spec.ts avatar image assertion mirroring header test.
